pages.name: Competition Benchmarking
pages.note: Vite 6 · React 19 · the APPROVED Competition Benchmarking page (served at http://localhost:3095; confirmed 2026-10-07 — it replaces competition-benchmarking-v3, which an earlier version of this catalog measured and which is not used). All styling is hand-built in src/globals.css (design tokens + every component rule), outside the Design System workspace. Values read from that CSS and checked against the rendered page's computed styles (16px root): all 16 section heads share one eyebrow rule and one description rule.

patterns.note: Section eyebrow / supporting heading above a main section heading. The Design System DOES define it (OverheadText, SectionLabel — R4.8), so the audit audits against those and never consults this; the evidence is recorded because the approved pages do NOT agree with each other or with the DS: size 12–12.8px, weight 400–600, tracking 1.57–2.4px, and the Report Store's is neutral where the other two are Ken red.
